symbols.name: bit length
symbols.meaning: The number of binary digits of $n$, $b=\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$.
symbols.quote: Let $b=\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$ be the bit length of $n$, so $2^{b-1}<n\le2^b$

symbols.name: padded box size
symbols.meaning: The number of cells of the padded box, the product of the axis lengths.
symbols.quote: let $T$ be the padded box size, the product of the padded lengths $t_1,\dots,t_d$.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: The index of an axis, running from 1 to $d$.
symbols.quote: where $i$ indexes the axes from $1$ to $d$

symbols.name: size exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed constant exponent that sets the number of axes, $d=\lfloor b^{\epsilon}\rfloor$.
symbols.quote: Here $\epsilon$ is the size exponent, a fixed constant

symbols.name: longest axis length
symbols.meaning: The common length of the longest axes, a power of two, $u=2^\ell$.
symbols.quote: Let $u=2^\ell$ be the common length of the longest axes (the letter changes meaning here; the source calls it $r$).

symbols.name: short axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of axes whose length is $u/2$.
symbols.quote: The number of axes whose length is $u/2$ is $w=d\ell-\log_2T$

symbols.name: working precision
symbols.quote: and $p=6b$ is the working precision in bits

symbols.name: slack fraction
symbols.meaning: The slack fraction of the prime-interval bound, $\eta=1/(4d)$ on this page.
symbols.quote: The counting tool is a prime-interval bound with a slack fraction $\eta$ and a real scale $\xi$ (both letters change meaning here).

symbols.name: real scale
symbols.meaning: The real point at which the prime-interval bound is applied.
symbols.quote: The counting tool is a prime-interval bound with a slack fraction $\eta$ and a real scale $\xi$ (both letters change meaning here).

relations.quote: The distinct primes supply pairwise coprime lengths to the [Chinese-remainder map](chinese-remainder-map.md).
The lengths must give the separation that [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md) needs
The lengths $s_1,\dots,s_d$ set the place values of the [Mixed-radix digits](mixed-radix-digits.md) of the $S$ positions
so the lengths satisfy the pairwise form of [Coprime](coprime.md).
The lengths are chosen as distinct [Prime number](prime-number.md)s.
